items.summary_en: Non-profit FracTracker Alliance alleges regulators have exempted compounds used in drilling despite 2022 lawThe fossil-fuel industry is violating Colorado law by not disclosing which chemicals it uses in drilling, a new analysis by the FracTracker Alliance non-profit alleges, and state records show it has used illegal or dangerous compounds while fracking.Drilling chemicals can include xylene, toluene, benzene, Pfas and other dangerous toxicants, industry records and literature from other regions show. A first-in-the-nation 2022 Colorado law requires fossil-fuel operators and their suppliers to make public all chemicals used in “downhole oil and gas production”. But regulators have exempted compounds used in drilling, claiming that drilling is not part of production. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 非营利组织“FracTracker Alliance”指控称，尽管2022年已颁布相关法律，监管机构仍对钻井中使用的化合物予以豁免。化石燃料行业因未披露钻井过程中使用的化学品种类，违反了科罗拉多州法律， 非营利组织“FracTracker Alliance”的一项最新分析指出，且州政府记录显示，该行业在水力压裂过程中使用了非法或危险的化合物。行业记录及其他地区的文献显示，钻井化学品可能包含二甲苯、甲苯、苯、全氟烷基物质（PFAS）及其他危险有毒物质。 2022年科罗拉多州出台了一项全美首创的法律，要求化石燃料运营商及其供应商公开“井下油气生产”中使用的所有化学品。但监管机构却将钻井中使用的化合物排除在外，声称钻井不属于生产环节。继续阅读...

items.title: Greenhouse gas forcing dominates the recent strengthening of North Pacific Meridional Mode influence on ENSO
items.title_en: Greenhouse gas forcing dominates the recent strengthening of North Pacific Meridional Mode influence on ENSO
items.title_zh: 温室气体强迫是近期北太平洋子午模态对ENSO影响增强的主要原因
items.summary_en: The North Pacific Meridional Mode (NPMM) is a key extratropical trigger of El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) events, and its influence on ENSO has increased markedly in recent decades, offering a pathway to improve ENSO predictability. Yet, the relative contributions of external forcings versus internal variability to this intensified influence remain uncertain. Using multi-model simulation outputs from the Detection and Attribution Model Intercomparison Project and a suite of numerical experiments, we demonstrate that greenhouse gas (GHG) forcing dominates over internal variability in driving the recent strengthening of the NPMM–ENSO connection, whereas aerosol and natural forcings have minimal impact. GHG forcing enhances the wind–evaporation–sea surface temperature (SST) feedback over the subtropical North Pacific by elevating the background mean SST, which amplifies NPMM-induced westerly wind bursts over the western tropical Pacific and promotes ENSO development. Sensitivity experiments further demonstrate that GHG-induced SST increasing in the subtropical North Pacific enhances the atmospheric response associated with the NPMM. These findings reveal an important role of anthropogenic forcing in modulating the extratropical impact on ENSO and suggest potential opportunities for extending ENSO prediction lead times.
items.summary_zh: 北太平洋子午向模态（NPMM）是厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）事件的一个关键副热带触发因素，近几十年来其对ENSO的影响显著增强，为提高ENSO的可预测性提供了途径。 然而，外部强迫与内部变率对这种增强影响的相对贡献仍不确定。 利用“检测与归因模型互比项目”的多模型模拟结果以及一系列数值实验，我们证明，在驱动近期 NPMM 与 ENSO 联系加强的过程中，温室气体（GHG）强迫比内部变异性起主导作用，而气溶胶和自然强迫的影响微乎其微。 温室气体强迫通过提高背景平均海表温度（SST），增强了副热带北太平洋地区的风-蒸发-海表温度（SST）反馈，从而放大了热带西太平洋地区由北太平洋多波段模态（NPMM）引发的西风突增，并促进了ENSO的发展。 敏感性实验进一步表明，北太平洋副热带地区由温室气体引起的SST升高，增强了与NPMM相关的大气响应。这些发现揭示了人为强迫在调节副热带对ENSO影响方面的重要作用，并为延长ENSO预测提前期提供了潜在的可能性。

items.title: A bottom-up social cost of carbon for Latin America: municipality-level heat-mortality damage functions from 30 million daily death records
items.title_en: A bottom-up social cost of carbon for Latin America: municipality-level heat-mortality damage functions from 30 million daily death records
items.title_zh: 拉丁美洲的自下而上碳社会成本：基于3000万条每日死亡记录的市镇级高温致死损害函数
items.summary_en: Temperature–mortality response functions have been quantified across many climate zones, but for most of the developing world they have not been translated into country-specific economic damages at sub-national resolution. This study estimates bottom-up mortality social costs of carbon (SCC) for five Latin American countries at municipality resolution. We assemble 30 million daily death records across 10 214 municipality-equivalent units in Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador and Peru (2000–2023) and merge them with the ARCO-ERA5 reanalysis sampled at every unit centroid. Country-specific Poisson exposure–response functions, estimated separately by country with municipality, year, month and day-of-week fixed effects, recover same-day heat-mortality semi-elasticities of 10.9% (Brazil) and 13.0% (Mexico) at a daily maximum temperature of 35 °C or above, relative to a 20 °C–25°C reference. Translating these functions along the SSP2-4.5 warming path, with the transient climate response to cumulative emissions, an income-driven attenuation of the response, a value-of-statistical-life path that rises with projected income, and population ageing, yields central mortality SCCs of about USD 0.5/tCO2 in Brazil and USD 0.3/tCO2 in Mexico at a 2% discount rate, with a small negative value for cool-climate Chile and near-zero values for Ecuador and Peru. These bottom-up, mortality-only estimates are a fraction of full-system country-level SCCs but share their cross-country ordering and signs, and the underlying damage functions imply a substantial annual heat-mortality burden that the sparse regional evidence in global assessments does not capture.
items.summary_zh: 虽然已在许多气候区对温度与死亡率的响应函数进行了量化，但对于大多数发展中国家而言，这些结果尚未转化为具有亚国家分辨率的国家特定经济损失。本研究以市镇为分辨率，估算了五个拉丁美洲国家的自下而上的碳死亡率社会成本（SCC）。 我们汇集了巴西、墨西哥、智利、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁10 214个相当于市镇的行政单位（2000–2023年）的3000万条每日死亡记录，并将这些数据与以每个单位中心点为采样点的ARCO-ERA5再分析数据进行了合并。 针对各国分别估算的泊松分布暴露-反应函数（采用市镇、年、月及星期几的固定效应），得出的当日高温致死率半弹性系数分别为10.9%（巴西）和13.0% （墨西哥），该值以每日最高气温达到35 °C或以上为条件，并以20 °C–25 °C为基准。 将这些函数沿SSP2-4.5变暖路径进行转换——考虑了累积排放量引发的瞬态气候响应、由收入驱动的响应减弱效应，以及随预期收入增长而上升的统计生命价值路径， 以及人口老龄化等因素，在2%的贴现率下，巴西的中心死亡率SCC约为0.5美元/吨二氧化碳，墨西哥约为0.3美元/吨二氧化碳；而气候凉爽的智利呈现微小的负值，厄瓜多尔和秘鲁则接近零。 这些自下而上、仅考虑死亡因素的估算值虽仅占国家层面全系统社会成本（SCC）的一小部分，但其跨国排序和正负符号与全系统估算一致；且其基础损害函数表明，每年存在巨大的高温致死负担，而全球评估中稀少的区域证据并未捕捉到这一点。

items.title: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance
items.title_en: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance
items.title_zh: 韧性作为水治理的基本原则
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-yWater governance often treats resilience as an end state, achieved mainly through technocratic decision-making and standard engineering tools. Drawing on five international cases, we argue that resilience should instead guide governance design and operation through adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》（Nature Sustainability），在线发表于：2026年11月17日；doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-y 水治理往往将韧性视为一种最终状态，主要通过技术官僚式的决策和标准工程工具来实现。 基于五个国际案例，我们认为，韧性应通过适应性、协调性、学习能力和问责机制，来指导治理的设计与运作。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-02002-7With 2030 and the conclusion of the current round of Sustainable Development Goals on the horizon, the world has entered a state of water bankruptcy. A collection of opinion and research explores how this bankruptcy affects environmental and social systems and asks how we return to sustainable and resilient water futures.

items.title: Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock
items.title_en: Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock
items.title_zh: 隐秘的生态系统：科学家发现单块深海岩石内栖息着245种动物
items.summary_en: Deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, scientists have discovered tiny hidden ecosystems inside metal-rich rocks that take millions of years to form. Researchers examined 244 nodules and found more than 4,100 animals living in their cracks and cavities, including unique communities unlike those in the surrounding seafloor mud. These remarkable miniature habitats could now be threatened by deep-sea mining for valuable metals.
items.summary_zh: 在太平洋深处，科学家们在富含金属的岩石内部发现了微小的隐蔽生态系统，这些岩石的形成历经数百万年。 研究人员对244个结核进行了考察，发现其裂缝和空隙中栖息着4,100余种动物，其中包括与周围海底泥层中截然不同的独特生物群落。如今，这些非凡的微型栖息地可能正面临着深海采矿活动对贵金属开采的威胁。

items.title: Vertical characteristics of HCHO and NO2 in suburban Shanghai: understanding of ozone formation sensitivity via secondary HCHO
items.title_en: Vertical characteristics of HCHO and NO2 in suburban Shanghai: understanding of ozone formation sensitivity via secondary HCHO
items.title_zh: 上海郊区甲醛（HCHO）和二氧化氮（NO₂）的垂直特征：通过二次甲醛（HCHO）理解臭氧形成的敏感性
items.summary_en: Since ozone (O3) pollution in China is on the rise, vertical distribution of nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and formaldehyde (HCHO) and their role towards O3 formation are critical towards designing O3 control strategies. Seasonal characteristics of aerosols, HCHO and NO2 were investigated over suburban Shanghai using multi-axis differential optical absorption spectroscopy from June 2020 to May 2021. For HCHO, the highest average vertical mixing ratios (VMRs) were observed for summer (0.775 ppb), followed by autumn (0.719 ppb), spring (0.718 ppb) and winter (0.672 ppb) at ground level. Seasonal trends in NO2 VMRs were observed to be opposite to that of HCHO with peak values occurring during winter (2.212 ppb) at the ground level followed by autumn (1.881 ppb), spring (1.415 ppb) and summer (1.124 ppb). In vertical, aerosols depicted a Gaussian shape with a higher values between 0.2–0.5 km. An exponential decay in NO2 VMRs is observed from 0.0 km to 3.0 km while the integral component of HCHO was found to be concentrated up to 2.0 km particularly during summer months. The vertical distribution of NO2 in different seasons mainly appeared below 0.5 km, while that of HCHO appeared within the range of 0.2–1.0 km. Both aerosols and NO2 tend to be higher during haze days compared to non-haze days while HCHO was found to be higher during non-haze days owing to high photochemical activity on a clear day. Based on the ratio of HCHO to NO2 (RFN), this study attempted to quantify the vertical characteristics of O3 sensitivity for different seasons. The results indicated that the O3 sensitivity was VOC-limited both at lower (generally, 0.0–0.6 km) and higher heights (1.8–3.0 km) while some transition limited scenarios were found at middle height (0.7–1.7 km) particularly during daytime. The results depicted that secondary HCHO is a crucial factor controlling on O3 sensitivity over Shanghai where enhanced ratio of VOC limited regime was observed with secondary HCHO for all the seasons.
items.summary_zh: 鉴于中国臭氧（O₃）污染呈上升趋势，二氧化氮（NO₂）和甲醛（HCHO）的垂直分布及其在臭氧形成中的作用，对于制定臭氧控制策略至关重要。 2020年6月至2021年5月期间，利用多轴差分光学吸收光谱仪，对上海郊区气溶胶、HCHO和NO₂的季节性特征进行了研究。 就甲醛而言，地面平均垂直混合比（VMR）在夏季最高（0.775 ppb），其次是秋季（0.719 ppb）、春季（0.718 ppb）和冬季（0.672 ppb）。 二氧化氮（NO₂）垂直混合比的季节变化趋势与甲醛（HCHO）相反，地面水平峰值出现在冬季（2.212 ppb），其次是秋季（1.881 ppb）、 春季（1.415 ppb）和夏季（1.124 ppb）。 在垂直方向上，气溶胶呈高斯分布，0.2–0.5 km高度区间内浓度较高。NO₂体积浓度从0.0 km到3.0 km呈现指数衰减，而甲醛的积分成分则主要集中在2.0 km以下，特别是在夏季。 不同季节中，NO₂的垂直分布主要出现在0.5公里以下，而HCHO的垂直分布则出现在0.2–1.0公里范围内。 与无雾天相比，雾天期间气溶胶和 NO2 的浓度往往较高，而由于晴天光化学活性较高，无雾天期间 HCHO 的浓度则较高。 基于甲醛与二氧化氮的比值（RFN），本研究试图量化不同季节臭氧敏感性的垂直特征。 结果表明，无论在较低高度（通常为 0.0–0.6 公里）还是较高高度（1.8–3.0 公里），O3 敏感性均受 VOC 限制，而在中等高度（0.7–1.7 公里），特别是在白天，发现了一些过渡性限制情况。 结果表明，二次甲醛是控制上海地区O3敏感性的关键因素，在所有季节中，伴随二次甲醛出现时，VOC限制型状况的比例均有所增强。

items.title: Delayed seasonal march of East Asian summer monsoonal rain belt during Heinrich Stadials
items.title_en: Delayed seasonal march of East Asian summer monsoonal rain belt during Heinrich Stadials
items.title_zh: 海因里希冰期期间东亚夏季季风雨带季节性移动的延迟现象
items.summary_en: The timing and duration of monsoon rainfall shape regional hydroclimate, yet their response to abrupt climate change remains poorly constrained. Here, we use 25-km-resolution climate simulations to investigate the seasonal migration of the East Asian summer monsoon rain belt during Heinrich Stadials, periods associated with collapsed Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC). We find that the rain belt migrated northward 18 d later than during interstadials. This delay kept the monsoon front longer over central China, prolonging early-summer rainfall despite an overall weaker monsoon. The delayed migration was linked to later northward advances of the western North Pacific subtropical high and upper-level westerly jet. North Atlantic cooling contributed to these circulation changes through Rossby wave propagation and a weakened land–sea thermal contrast. Our results suggest that abrupt Atlantic changes can reshape both the amount and seasonal timing of East Asian summer rainfall. These findings offer a palaeoclimate perspective on potential changes in monsoon seasonality under future AMOC weakening.
items.summary_zh: 季风降水的时序和持续时间塑造了区域水文气候，但其对突发性气候变化的响应仍缺乏充分约束。本文利用25公里分辨率的气候模拟，研究了海因里希冰期（与大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）崩溃相关的时期）期间东亚夏季季风雨带的季节性迁移。 我们发现，与间冰期相比，雨带向北迁移的时间推迟了18天。这种延迟使季风锋面在中国中部滞留的时间更长，尽管整体季风强度减弱，但初夏降雨期仍得以延长。雨带迁移的延迟与西北太平洋副热带高压及高空西风急流向北推进的推迟有关。 北大西洋的冷却通过罗斯贝波的传播以及陆海热力对比的减弱，促成了这些环流变化。我们的研究结果表明，大西洋的突变可以重塑东亚夏季降雨的总量及其季节性时序。这些发现从古气候学的角度，为未来AMOC减弱背景下季风季节性的潜在变化提供了参考。

items.title: Scientists discover a surprisingly simple way to turn coffee waste into fuel
items.title_en: Scientists discover a surprisingly simple way to turn coffee waste into fuel
items.title_zh: 科学家发现了一种将咖啡废料转化为燃料的出人意料的简单方法
items.summary_en: Scientists have developed an efficient method to transform used coffee grounds into a potential source of biodiesel while preserving the leftover material for other renewable fuels and valuable chemicals. The discovery could turn millions of tons of discarded coffee waste into a surprisingly useful resource for sustainable energy.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们开发出一种高效方法，能够将用过的咖啡渣转化为生物柴油的潜在原料，同时保留剩余物质用于生产其他可再生燃料和有价值的化学品。这一发现有望将数百万吨被丢弃的咖啡废弃物转化为一种对可持续能源而言出人意料的有用资源。
